author: Karl Rock
description:
Most architecture in this region relies heavily on classic white marble, but the tombs of Makli tell a different story. Instead of the expected stone, these structures showcase a stunning, vibrant blue glaze that defies the traditional aesthetic.

Drawing inspiration from Turkish design, these intricate blue tiles and stone carvings have withstood the test of time, offering a rare glimpse into a unique fusion of cultural influences. It’s a remarkable departure from the expected, revealing hidden layers of artistry tucked away in the landscape of Pakistan.
title: The Secret of Pakistan’s Blue Tiles
